Private Sub Edit(ByVal which As Long, c As Object, r As Variant)
    Select Case which
    Case 1: c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB
    Case 2: c.SeriesCollection(2).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 65280: r = c.SeriesCollection(2).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB
    Case 3: c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 65280: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB
    Case 4: c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.Visible = msoFalse: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.Visible
    Case 5: c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.Transparency = 0.5: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.Transparency
    Case 6: c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.Solid: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.Type
    Case 7: c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB = 255: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB
    Case 8: c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Line.Weight = 2: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Line.Weight
    Case 9: c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB = 255: c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Line.Weight = 2: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Line.Weight
    Case 10: c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Line.Visible = msoFalse: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Line.Visible
    Case 11: c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB = 255: c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Line.DashStyle = msoLineDash: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Line.DashStyle
    Case 12: c.SeriesCollection(1).Interior.Color = 255: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Interior.Color
    Case 13: c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB = 65280: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB
    Case 14: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB
    Case 15: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(2).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(2).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB
    Case 16: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB = 255: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB
    Case 17: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 65280: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB
    Case 18: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(2).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 65280: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB
    End Select
End Sub

Public Function Act(ByVal path As String, ByVal out As String, ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, c As Object, r As Variant, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(path)
    Set c = wb.Worksheets(1).ChartObjects(1).Chart
    On Error Resume Next
    Edit which, c, r
    s = Err.Number & " " & TypeName(r) & " " & r
    On Error GoTo 0
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    wb.SaveAs out, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    wb.Close False
    Act = s
End Function
